name: gated-development-orchestration
description: Coordinate human-verifiable checkpoint development through persistent ChatGPT governance and implementation threads, fresh Codex evidence/testing sessions, and independent review.

interface.shortDescription: Orchestrate product checkpoints through specialized development rounds
interface.longDescription: Coordinates human-verifiable product checkpoints through Definition, Discovery, Implementation, Evidence / Testing, and Independent Review rounds. Definition, Discovery, and Independent Review use a persistent governance ChatGPT thread; Implementation uses a separate persistent ChatGPT thread; every Evidence / Testing round starts a fresh Codex session. GitHub is the authoritative workflow ledger and propagates both persistent ChatGPT thread IDs through lifecycle comments.
defaultPrompt: Define a human-verifiable feature and checkpoint plan.
Perform the required Definition, Discovery, Implementation, Evidence / Testing, or Independent Review round under the v3 worker model.
Review the latest checkpoint state and route the next round without collapsing product, implementation, evidence, and acceptance authority.
